criteria.criterion: AR01 immutable selected context across awaits
criteria.detail: Retained selector object mutated at native model/request logging after assembly; actual request remained original, including tool value and trusted instructions.

criteria.criterion: AR02 healthy native writer records failed RESPOND and aligned cursor
criteria.detail: Model throw, selector throw/deadline/duplicate/trust tampering, system/request overflow, token/cost overage, result-log failure all preserve native accounting and actual failed row. MODEL_FAILURE/INTERNAL_FAILURE retry policy intentionally preserved.

criteria.criterion: AR03 audit veto preserves actual acknowledged step and durable refusal
criteria.detail: SUCCEEDED native response row remains SUCCEEDED; healthy checkpoint writer records INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. Healthy terminal replay refuses.

criteria.criterion: AR04 uncertain step/checkpoint writer conservative native accounting and effects
criteria.detail: Actual model-call usage disappears across a failed post-response checkpoint and a restored writer. A18 completes after two calls with maxModelCalls=1 while claiming one; A21 repeats a prior failed empty RESPOND and loses its actual usage. Tool journal and body remain intact.
Native deadline denies unanswered selector; system and total request overflow deny before model; actual token/cost overages are charged once then stopped through native pipeline.
